entities.name: SdhE FAD assembly factor
observations: 91-aa sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q47WN6 from Colwellia psychrerythraea; annotated as a cytoplasmic FAD assembly factor required for covalent flavinylation of SdhA during succinate dehydrogenase complex II assembly.
Sequence-derived properties: 10.67 kDa predicted mass, pI 4.91; Pfam Sdh5 domain PF03937 spans residues 16–88.
